segments.text: American Fork City Council — Work Session — June 2, 2026:

During a Victim Advocacy Program presentation, Mayor Frost observed that victims can respond differently to law-enforcement intervention, including when they have a relationship with the person arrested. An advocate explained how the program helps victims understand their options and focus on safety and recovery.

entities.label: Victim Advocacy Program and law-enforcement response

segments.text: During a report on the Victim Advocacy Program, Mayor Frost and the advocates discussed how victims may react to law-enforcement intervention and how advocates provide support.
Relevant discussion from the official meeting minutes:

Mayor Frost noted that victims respond differently to law enforcement actions, with some feeling relieved and others struggling because of their relationship with the offender. Ms. Whiting agreed, explaining that advocates help victims understand their options, process events, and focus on safety and recovery.
